ξενιζω.gloss: I entertain a stranger, I startle
ξενιζω.def: (a) I entertain a stranger, (b) I startle, bewilder.

ξενοσ.def: alien, new, novel; noun: a guest, stranger, foreigner.

ξεστησ.def: a Roman measure, a pitcher or cup of any size.

ξηραινω.def: I dry up, parch, am ripened, wither, waste away.

ξυλον.gloss: a staff, cross, anything made of wood
ξυλον.def: anything made of wood, a piece of wood, a club, staff; the trunk of a tree, used to support the cross-bar of a cross in crucifixion.

ξυραω.def: I shave, shear, cut off the hair.
